name: Pull request reviewer
why: Rates risk and ranks findings on each new pull request, then posts the review only after you say yes, the same flow as the code review skill.

name: Review a pull request, fix the comments and sign off
why: Takes a review through to fixed comments and a one-page sign-off, for when the author needs help addressing review comments.

name: Fix a bug with proof and a clear pull request
why: Proves the cause before any fix and ends in a minimal pull request, matching the bug diagnosis skill.

name: Turn a bug report into proof
why: Turns a vague bug report into a repeatable case and the missing tests, the first half of debugging.

name: Private bug evidence assistant
why: Helps non-developers turn rough notes and screenshots into a bug report with private data removed.

name: Test failure repair loop
why: Fixes a red test suite in capped rounds, re-checking each time, useful after an upgrade step.

name: Make a code change in small tested steps with AI
why: Splits a change into small tested steps with rules for an AI coding helper, the same small-step habit as safe refactoring.

name: Monthly tech debt keeper
why: Finds new debt each month and ranks the next small fixes, feeding the codebase health check.

name: Weekly dependency and security sweep
why: Tracks dependency and security changes weekly with an upgrade order, the early warning for the upgrade plan skill.

name: Write docs a new developer can follow on day one
why: Produces an architecture read, README and quickstart, the written side of the codebase map prompt.

name: Monthly developer docs keeper
why: Keeps developer docs current after changes, so onboarding notes do not go stale.

name: Release manager
why: A go or no-go, changelog and rollback plan before each release, the last step after an upgrade or fix.

name: Make your repo agent ready
why: Scores how ready a repository is for AI coding helpers, useful before letting AI write changes for review.
